title: DMAE for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: DMAE for Hair & Skin: What the Research Shows | FullyVital
seo_description: What DMAE is, what a facial-skin trial and lab studies show, its regulatory status in supplements, and why there is no evidence it helps hair.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Old post (0 study links) claimed hair benefits. Removed; rewritten around skin research and the regulatory point.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
No hair evidence exists; evidence too thin for a standard refresh. If any FullyVital product contains DMAE, check the 'unauthorized in the EU' line against your market.
Grossman 2005 reviews a trial; the dose and durations are from that review's abstract.
'Used in topical anti-wrinkle products and has been sold in supplements' is from the Morissette and Jędrejko abstracts.
